title: Standalone supplied-arrival ruin and temple discovery v1 JSON interchange structures
description: Closed scenario, envelope, receipt, state and trace, plus API-result definitions. Authored statically; no product, example, test, compiler, typecheck or schema validation was run. Shape alone proves neither native fidelity nor history reachability. Runtime checks all raw references, exact registered policy, complete frozen arrival sequence, derived snapshots/receipts/RNG and canonical saved genesis. Shared hard budgets are 16MiB UTF-8 per full input/output, depth24, nodes1048576, arrays4096 and object keys128; the escaped SaveResult and all old-ID results are included. These maxima are not promised jointly attainable, efficient, or benchmarked. Only non-Proxy plain/null-prototype own-data JSON DTOs are supported. Runtime reflection may invoke Proxy traps; hostile Proxies or runtime pollution are not universally detectable or isolated. Accessors, symbols, inherited data, sparse arrays, unsafe/negative-zero/nonfinite numbers and duplicate decoded JSON object keys are rejected in the supported input domain. Replay validates consistency against the supplied genesis; it is not a signature or independent authentication of a coordinated rewrite. Source/guide observations and synthetic policies remain separate, provisional layers. No native skill98 table, world-state, old corpus execution flag or O13-A ledger is changed.

site.description: Initial states are false/false with null source or true/true with source. Initial temple ordinals must be unique and exactly 1..N; ruins have null ordinal. Runtime checks identities and placement.

guideCatalog.description: Complete supplied catalog for this scenario, not the native 98 table. Pools are nonempty, disjoint, total at most 256 and refer only to listed skills. Actor skillRef may also reference a catalog skill outside both offer pools. Source references are recorded, not authenticated.

scenario.description: All raw records are validated before use. Same force/ordinary roster, no member in two units; sites outside ground. Full ordered arrival facts must chain from each initial unit position, have axial distance one, stay on supplied ground, never reverse global dates, and occur at most once per unit per ten-day period. This does not validate original movement legality or costs. Collections canonicalize by ID or q/r; arrival order is preserved.

discovery.description: Supplied initial records carry only their source identity and optional temple ordinal; command, arrival, unit and date are null. Runtime discovery records carry command, arrival, unit and date, with null sourceId. The temple ordinal is derived, never a free counter.

credit.description: Actual=min(requested,cap-before); discarded=requested-actual; after=before+actual. Charm XP requests 10/cap1e9, ruin raw talent requests1/cap255, aptitude requests1/cap3. Runtime reconstructs every value.

templeWrite.description: Same skill is accepted and consumes the pending reward: requested1, actual0, discarded1, relearned=true. A changed skill records requested1, actual1, discarded0. No refund or second XP award.
